definitions.explanation: a victory achieved without much difficulty or struggle

examples.japanese: ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{快勝|かいしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収|おさ}めた→収める：02022_osameru⟧。
examples.english: The team achieved an easy victory.

examples.japanese: 5-1⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{快勝|かいしょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{初戦|しょせん}→初戦：21654_shosen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{快勝|かいしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飾|かざ}った→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: They kicked off with a comfortable victory in the first match.

notes:
USAGE:
- {快勝|かいしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to win easily)
- {快勝|かいしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収|おさ}める→収める：02022_osameru⟧ (to achieve an easy victory)
- {快勝|かいしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧ (to adorn with an easy victory)
Implies the victory was achieved smoothly and with relative ease, not necessarily by a huge margin but without significant struggle.

VICTORY SCALE (by margin/effort):
- ⟦{圧勝|あっしょう}→圧勝：07903_asshou⟧ (overwhelming victory - dominant)
- {大勝|たいしょう} (big win - by large margin)
- {快勝|かいしょう} (easy win - comfortable)
- ⟦{辛勝|しんしょう}→辛勝：08238_shinshou⟧ (narrow win - hard-fought)

RELATED WORDS:
